_comment: T473 D2/D3 (owner, 2026-09-27) — the deployable apps and what each one is BUILT FROM. An app's fingerprint is the git content ids of its inputs at the release commit; an app whose fingerprint equals the last DEPLOYED release's is skipped (`just deploy --all` forces every app). Inputs are paths in the app's repo; `@umbrella:<path>` is a path in the workspace repo. The umbrella justfile is an input of every app on purpose: a change to how apps deploy redeploys them (slower, never wrong). A declared input that does not exist is an error, so this file cannot silently drift from the tree.

tracked_not_deployed._comment: Recorded in every release manifest so a release shows what changed, but not skipped or selected: `db-migrate` applies whatever is pending, and applies nothing when nothing is.
